thesis: Keith Wasserman argues that multifamily apartments and mobile home parks are superior real estate investments because they offer stable, recession-proof cash flows with lower vacancy and tenant improvement risks compared to office or retail properties. He further contends that manufactured housing represents the best risk-adjusted return opportunity as it functions as affordable housing where investors rent land rather than own structures, thereby avoiding heavy capital expenditures and maintenance costs.
